prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, two women in a single row.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side in the aisle of a passenger airplane cabin with rows of grey seats on both sides, overhead luggage bins, small oval windows, cool white cabin lighting, a grey carpeted floor. Behind them, several ordinary passengers sitting in the seats and standing in the aisle are softly out of focus, their figures and faces blurred by shallow depth of field into gentle shapes and colours, while the women stay razor sharp in the foreground, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 2 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, the cool white light of the cabin raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, with the polished look of a C-pop idol, smooth high cheekbones with a gently tapering jaw and a small round chin, large clear almond eyes with a soft double lid, willow-leaf brows, a small nose and small full lips, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a calm, distant gaze, cool ash-brown hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real living eyes. Long round nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern — a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense stepped geometric borders filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the floor beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips.

Left woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other woman, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the floor, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Left woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the floor.

Right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, a composed expression with a faint weariness in her eyes, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework — an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense fine filigree linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the floor beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips.

Right woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other woman, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the floor, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Right woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the floor.

Composition: the whole row of women fills the width of the tall frame, each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the light carving every fold and curve on all 2, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 vertical portrait 8K, taller than it is wide.
